title: The Emergentist Manifesto: A Worldview for Finite Beings
subtitle: A full staged reader built from current sources, open research, and visible correction records.
semantic_owner_rule: Every substantive proposition inherits its named claim card; K-1 through K-7 remain its semantic owners.
source_revision_rule: Each named card inherits the exact source path and reviewed SHA-256 from its canonical claim-card set; no duplicate source revision becomes authoritative here.

target_word_range.meaning: editorial target for a completed private full-reader manuscript, not its present length or a release promise

lifecycle_classes.current_body: Only bounded_current cards may support affirmative reader prose. Conjectural wording stays conditional and every public gate remains unpaid.
lifecycle_classes.research_record: Candidate or source_only cards may appear only in conspicuously labelled private research chapters with their rival, discriminator, and narrowing or kill route.
lifecycle_classes.historical_provenance: Critical editions and debriefs may document lineage and correction without silently modernizing legacy text or supplying current authority.
lifecycle_classes.custody_only: Frozen material may be identified by route and provenance but may not be regenerated as explanatory prose.
lifecycle_classes.barred: Withheld, uncarded, retired, or otherwise barred material cannot enter manuscript prose or any public projection.

completion_requirements: Every substantive paragraph in a drafted chapter has a unique marker, claim-card IDs, source-work IDs, inherited source revision, lifecycle class, evidence tier, and public disposition.
Every current_body chapter uses only bounded_current cards and no wording exceeds its card public ceiling.
Every research_record chapter retains a named rival, discriminator, kill or narrow condition, and a no-public-body label.
Historical and custody sections preserve links, hashes, and debrief routes without regenerated frozen claims.
No public edition is built until the source-card, lifecycle, barred-claim, parity, fresh-reader, hostile-review, deterministic-build, and public-boundary gates all pass.

parts.title: Preamble — The Map That Can Lose
Part III — Collective Life Without Collective Personhood
Part IV — The Frontier Stated Honestly

chapters.title: Preamble and Quickstart
chapters.reader_job: Give a compressed, testable invitation and rules for using or leaving the book.
chapters.boundary: Part 0 is not a separate manifesto or a semantic owner.

chapters.title: The Finite Predicament
chapters.reader_job: Begin with embodiment, consequence, mystery, and the need to act without a completed map.
chapters.boundary: No ontology, consciousness solution, or death claim follows from finite agency.

chapters.title: Frames Are Not Furniture
chapters.reader_job: Establish the distinction between selected language, ordinary mathematics, and reality.
chapters.boundary: Titan framing is optional; ordinary mathematics is neither altered nor solved by it.

chapters.title: Probability, Record, and Possibility
chapters.reader_job: Separate probability-bearing descriptions, possible alternatives, available means, and observed outcomes.
chapters.boundary: The two-axis profile requires declared calibration before scalar use; selected translation language transfers neither truth nor Justice.

chapters.title: A Loop That Can Learn
chapters.reader_job: Give a reader-facing account of map, action, receipt, correction, and exit.
chapters.boundary: A receipt is contestable outcome evidence, not a self-awarded success story.

chapters.title: The Finity Card
chapters.reader_job: Present a voluntary seven-prompt decision worksheet without claiming efficacy or authorization.
chapters.boundary: The Finity Card is not formal Finity, a mandate, or a proven improvement over ordinary worksheets.

chapters.title: Justice Is Chosen
chapters.reader_job: Show the constitutional choice and its relation to finite, equal-worth bearers.
chapters.boundary: No calculation, geometry, symbolic frame, adherence count, or human rank derives duty.

chapters.title: Conflict, Responsibility, and Residue
chapters.reader_job: Treat conflict as a causal question with visible bearers rather than an identity or holy-war story.
chapters.boundary: Worldview coordination remains one candidate causal variable, never a universal cause or a license for violence.

chapters.title: The Social Loop and Collective Traces
chapters.reader_job: Explain how traces can coordinate without turning a collective into a person.
chapters.boundary: Egregoreotype is a five-marker candidate description, never consciousness, moral agency, or collective personhood.

chapters.title: Thin Coordination Across Difference
chapters.reader_job: Use a bounded exchange observation to distinguish interoperable signals from shared worldview or moral agreement.
chapters.boundary: Macaque object-for-food episodes are bounded learned exchange, not human contracting, consent, fairness, or proof of a memotype theory.

chapters.title: Institutions That Can End
chapters.reader_job: Make correction, equal worth, and exit the present constitutional limits on institutional language.
chapters.boundary: The Evolutionary Network is not imported here as a programme; its source-only proposal stays in Part IV.

chapters.title: Worldview Competition Without a War Metaphysics
chapters.reader_job: Clarify that a framework can compete by clarity and correction without treating opponents as enemy kinds.
chapters.boundary: Competition is not validation; conflict explanations stay plural and no chapter authorizes coercion, exclusion, or total war.

chapters.title: Titans and Finity: A Research Programme
chapters.reader_job: State the formal project, standard-mathematics primacy, recovery obligations, and failure conditions without declaring an algebra or ontology complete.
chapters.boundary: Use only carded research-edition material. Uncarded modules, completed-algebra claims, total ontology, universal paradox resolution, and science unification are barred.

chapters.title: What Translation and World Contact Must Earn
chapters.reader_job: Show which D-system, macro-description, temporal, language, emergence, and Finity-benefit claims remain open and how they could fail.
chapters.boundary: Each claim keeps its named rival, discriminator, and kill criterion. Internal coherence, poetry, and reader agreement do not pay the world-contact debt.

chapters.title: Accountable Action and Institutional Experiments
chapters.reader_job: Route Justice, resistance, institutional design, repair, and dissolution to their staged source-only inquiries.
chapters.boundary: No sacred command, physical-force permission, network runtime, membership, enforcement organism, or state project is supplied.

chapters.title: Six Lenses and the Capture Problem
chapters.reader_job: Make plural inquiry and hostile review visible without claiming that a framework can certify its own safety.
chapters.boundary: No complete analytical genome, privileged access, self-audit safety certificate, or governance authority follows.

chapters.title: What the Genealogy Keeps and Kills
chapters.reader_job: Preserve a correction record without reviving the historical book as current doctrine.
chapters.boundary: Use only the corrected critical edition and debrief; do not revive archive-only formula, hierarchy, prophecy, sovereignty, recruitment, or correspondence-as-proof claims.

chapters.title: Exit, Record, and the Right to Put It Down
chapters.reader_job: Close the reader with nonclosure, correction, retained records, and voluntary departure.
chapters.boundary: Exit does not erase consequence, repair, ownership, or historical custody.

non_negotiable_refusals: A theorem is not an ontology.
A model is not the territory.
A symbol is not a causal agent.
Justice is not derived merely because a geometry is elegant.
A worldview is not validated by adherents, popularity, publication, or AI agreement.
Any holder may put it down.
